hero.label: Khmer Foods Group — A Cambodian Family Story Since 1994
hero.title: From Cambodian Farms to the World
hero.description: Since 1994, we've partnered with farming cooperatives across Cambodia to mill and export the country's finest rice. Every grain carries the care of our farmers and the quality our company has stood behind for three decades.

about.label: Our Story
about.title: Three Decades of Rice, From Humble Beginnings
about.paragraph1: Khmer Foods Group started in 1994 as a small family trading business, buying and selling rice in local Cambodian markets. With patience, hard work, and a deep respect for the farmers who grew our grains, we slowly built relationships that would last generations.
about.paragraph2: By 1999, we had established our first milling facility in Kampong Speu. For 32 years now, we've been refining our craft — learning every detail of what makes Cambodian rice some of the finest in the world. We began exporting in 2009, and today our rice reaches families across six continents.
about.paragraph3: We work hand-in-hand with contract farming cooperatives across Cambodia, ensuring a reliable supply of high-quality paddy while supporting the communities that have been part of our journey from the very beginning.

products.label: Grown With Care
products.title: Our Products
products.description: Each variety we mill has a story — passed down through generations of Cambodian farmers in our cooperative network. We select, harvest, and process with the same care we'd give our own family's dinner table. All varieties are available under your own OEM brand, with packaging and logistics tailored to your market.

phkaRumduol.name: Phka Rumduol
phkaRumduol.description: Cambodia's crown jewel — a fragrant jasmine rice so exquisite it has been crowned World's Best Rice six times. Each grain is long, glossy, and carries the natural perfume of our wet-season paddies.

senKroOub.name: Sen Kro Oub (SKO)
senKroOub.description: A dry-season treasure. Harvested under the warm April sun, these long, soft grains carry a delicate natural scent that reminds us of home. Cambodia's most beloved aromatic variety.

sroNge.name: Sro Nge (SRO)
sroNge.description: A reliable favorite — fragrant white rice that gives two to three harvests a year. Always there when you need it, with that same pleasant aroma Cambodian grandmothers have cherished for generations.

om5451.name: OM5451 White Rice
om5451.description: The workhorse of Cambodian fields — firm, white, and wonderfully versatile. This high-yielding variety has fed countless families and remains a favorite for bulk export to communities worldwide.

brownRice.name: Heritage Brown Rice
brownRice.description: Nutrient-rich whole grain with the bran layer lovingly left intact. Milled from our finest Phka Rumduol and SKO varieties — wholesome, hearty, and full of the earth's goodness.

redJasmine.name: Red Jasmine Rice
redJasmine.description: A rare Cambodian gem with a beautiful reddish bran layer and a nutty, earthy flavor. This distinctive grain connects you to centuries of Cambodian agricultural tradition.

brokenRice.name: Broken Rice
brokenRice.description: Nothing goes to waste in our mill. These tender fragments — born from the milling process — find new life in brewing, rice flour, and nourishing dishes around the world.

neangKhon.name: Neang Khon
neangKhon.description: A beloved Cambodian traditional white rice, also known as Pearl Rice. Neang Khon is a wet-season crop with medium grain length, prized for its slightly sticky texture and naturally sweet flavor. Popular in rural households across Cambodia's fertile northern regions, it's ideal for soups, porridge, and everyday family meals.

process.label: From Paddy to Pure Grain
process.title: Our Milling Process
process.description: Our mills in Kampong Speu are where tradition meets precision. Using trusted Buhler and Satake machinery — the same equipment that has served quality rice producers for decades — we process every batch with the same care and consistency.
process.supportingText: Every step is watched over by people who care. Our facilities carry BRCGS, ISO 22000, ISO 9001, HACCP, GMP, and HALAL certifications — not because we chase badges, but because we believe in doing things right.

step0.title: Paddy Receiving
step0.description: We select only high-purity paddy from our trusted contract farming partners across 2,463 hectares. Every batch is weighed, tested, and traced back to the cooperative that grew it.

step1.title: Paddy Drying
step1.description: Freshly harvested paddy is gently dried to just the right moisture level. Too much, and the grain cracks. Too little, and it won't mill properly. Our millers know the perfect balance by instinct.

step2.title: Husking & Cleaning
step2.description: The dried paddy passes through our cleaning and husking machines, where husks, stones, and impurities are carefully removed. What remains is beautiful brown rice — nature's gift, gently prepared.

step3.title: Rice Whitening
step3.description: Our Buhler UltraWhite machines gently remove the bran layer, revealing the pearly white grain beneath. We take our time here — patience is what separates good rice from great rice.

step4.title: Rice Polishing
step4.description: The Satake polishers give each grain its signature sheen — a natural glow that tells you this rice was cared for at every step. No shortcuts. No compromises.

step5.title: Color Sorting & Grading
step5.description: Our optical color sorters examine every single grain, removing any that don't meet our standards. Only the best make it through — because our name is on every bag.

step6.title: Quality Control
step6.description: Our QC team checks rice quality at every stage of production — moisture, grain length, whiteness, and aroma — ensuring every batch meets the exact specifications our customers expect.

step7.title: Packaging
step7.description: Flexible packaging options from 0.5kg retail pouches to 50kg export sacks and jumbo bags. Whatever your market needs, we pack it with care and precision.

step8.title: Metal Detector
step8.description: Every single bag passes through our metal detection system. It's our final safety check — because quality means nothing without trust.

step9.title: Carton Sealing
step9.description: Small retail packs are master-packed into sealed carton boxes, ready for supermarket shelves around the world. Neat, secure, and shelf-ready.

step10.title: Container Loading
step10.description: Finished goods are loaded directly into shipping containers at our facility. Full container loads (FCL) ensure your rice travels safely from our mill to your port.

step11.title: Lift to Train
step11.description: Containers are lifted onto railway flatcars right at our facility. No trucking, no delays — just a smooth transfer from mill to rail.

step12.title: Rail to Seaport
step12.description: Our railway-connected logistics carry containers directly to Cambodia's deep seaport. From paddies to port — a seamless supply chain you can count on.

farming.label: Rooted in Community
farming.title: Growing Together, Harvesting Hope
farming.subtitle: Our contract farming partnerships in Kampong Thom Province
farming.description: Under the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture, we've built lasting partnerships with farming cooperatives across 2,463 hectares. We don't just buy rice — we grow relationships. Our farmers are our neighbors, our friends, and the heart of everything we do.

cta.title: Let's Start a Conversation
cta.description: Whether you're a small shop looking for a reliable rice supplier or an importer seeking Cambodia's finest grains, we'd love to hear from you. We've been building relationships around rice for over 30 years — and we'd be honored to build one with you.

global.label: Global Export Destinations
global.title: Europe, Asia, Australia, North America & Africa
global.description: In 2024, Cambodia proudly exported 645,872 tonnes of rice to 68 countries. We're humbled to be part of this journey — sharing the fruits of our farmers' labor with families across six continents. Every shipment carries a piece of our home.

csr.label: Giving Back
csr.title: Caring for the Community That Raised Us
csr.description: We believe that a business built on the land has a responsibility to the people who live on it. That's why we dedicate a portion of every sale to supporting children, education, and healthcare in the communities that have supported us for three generations.
csr.hospitalDescription: Since 1999, this remarkable hospital in Siem Reap has provided over 2.5 million free medical treatments to Cambodian children. A portion of every Kroya Brand sale goes directly to keeping their doors open — because every child deserves a healthy start.
csr.schoolDescription: Nestled in the mountains of Kampong Speu, this innovative school gives children in remote areas access to education, life skills, and hope. Our rice donations help keep their students nourished and their classrooms full.
commitments: A portion of every Kroya Brand sale supports children's healthcare and education
We partner with organizations that uplift women and families in rural Cambodia
We believe every child deserves access to good food, good schools, and good health
Our farmers and their families are always our first priority

quality.label: Our Promise to You
quality.title: Quality You Can Trust, Standards You Can Verify
quality.description: We don't just talk about quality — we live it. Every batch is tested, every process is monitored, and every certification is earned. Because when our name is on the bag, we want you to feel as confident serving it as we do.
quality.quote: We don't just mill rice — we craft trust. From the moment paddy enters our facility to the final seal on the container, every process is designed with one thing in mind: the families who will sit down to eat it.
